subject: ela
skillName: Author's point of view and purpose
intro: Determine the author's purpose and point of view.

items.prompt:
The reason an author writes a text is the author's:
A) purpose
B) page count
C) name

steps: Why they wrote. Key is A.

items.prompt:
A persuasive editorial's purpose is to:
A) inform only
B) persuade
C) entertain only

Loaded, positive words suggest the author:
A) favors the topic
B) opposes it
C) has no view

steps: Positive words = approval. Key is A.

items.prompt:
Read.

'While some claim zoos are cruel, the evidence shows zoos protect endangered species.'

The author's position is that zoos are:
A) cruel
B) beneficial
C) unimportant

steps: Author counters the 'cruel' view. Key is B.

items.prompt:
In that sentence, how does the author distinguish their view from others'?
A) by naming the opposing view, then countering it with evidence
B) by ignoring all other views
C) by changing the topic
items.answer: A) by naming the opposing view, then countering it with evidence

steps: Acknowledge then refute. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) by naming the opposing view, then countering it with evidence

items.prompt:
The purpose of a how-to manual is mainly to:
A) instruct/inform
B) persuade
C) entertain

steps: Teach a task. Key is A.

items.prompt:
An author writes about a new highway, including only the traffic it will reduce and ignoring the homes it will destroy. This selection of facts reveals the author's:
A) neutral stance
B) point of view in favor of the highway
C) opposition to the highway
items.answer: B) point of view in favor of the highway

steps: Chosen facts show bias toward it. Key is B.
solution.answer: B) point of view in favor of the highway

items.prompt:
An author who writes, 'Critics worry about cost, but the long-term savings far outweigh it,' is:
A) hiding their view
B) distinguishing their position from the critics' by countering them
C) agreeing with the critics
items.answer: B) distinguishing their position from the critics' by countering them

steps: Acknowledge then rebut. Key is B.
solution.answer: B) distinguishing their position from the critics' by countering them
